evals.name: temporal-date-migration
evals.prompt: Upgrade this Vite + React project to TypeScript 6 and switch my date handling over to the new Temporal API. The countdown logic is in src/lib/countdown.ts.
evals.expected_output: TypeScript bumped to 6.0.x, tsconfig lib includes ESNext, countdown.ts rewritten to use Temporal (PlainDate/Duration), and a mention that running it needs Node 26 or a polyfill since this is runnable code.

evals.name: subpath-imports-and-map-upsert
evals.prompt: Use TypeScript 6's new features to clean up src/utils/registry.ts - it's got a bunch of ../../../ imports and a gross has/set/get map pattern.
evals.expected_output: Relative imports converted to #/ subpath imports with BOTH the package.json imports field and tsconfig paths added with moduleResolution bundler/nodenext, and the has/set/get pattern replaced with Map.getOrInsert().

evals.name: regexp-escape-search-highlight
evals.prompt: Add a search highlighter to my app that takes user input and highlights matches. Use the latest TypeScript 6 stuff to do it safely.
evals.expected_output: A highlighter that builds the RegExp with RegExp.escape() on the user input, with reasoning about why escaping matters (special chars like dots/parens), and tsconfig lib including ESNext.
